biography.plain_text: Ivan Shabalov is a Russian businessman and metallurgical researcher who founded pipe trading companies supplying Gazprom. He created the Northern European Pipe Project and Pipe Innovation Technologies, selling his controlling stake in the former. A graduate of the Moscow Institute of Steel and Alloys, he previously worked at the Bardin research institute.

long_biography.plain_text:
Russian entrepreneur Ivan Shabalov treated pipe trading as an engineering service. His team examined manufacturers’ production plans and recommended changes to reduce rejected output. He argued that customers needed technical assessment independent of the factory, with someone prepared to take responsibility for the judgement.

Delivery required coordination across several mills. Shabalov described scheduling their shipments so that a receiving railway station would not become blocked by too many wagons. His company also borrowed to pay manufacturers advances, bridging the period before Gazprom paid for delivered pipes. He viewed quality control, transport planning and finance as connected parts of the service.
